categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Haichuan Intelligent Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automatic weighing instruments. Its main products include microcomputer combination scales, loss-in-weight scales, inspection equipment, and related accessories. The company serves industries such as food, pharmaceuticals, plastics, and water supply with automated weighing, metering, and continuous batching solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates software technology, precision mechanical manufacturing, and electrical control in its production processes. It emphasizes a complete R&D system with over 154 patents, including invention patents and software copyrights. Production follows an 'order assembly' model, with customized product development to meet specific client needs, focusing on high-end intelligent weighing instruments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haichuan Intelligent serves a broad range of downstream industries including food processing, pharmaceuticals, plastics, and municipal water supply. Its products are used for weighing, metering, and continuous batching in these sectors. The company targets both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales generated from direct sales to industrial clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It also has subsidiaries in Taiwan and Germany, supporting international sales and operations. Domestic sales account for about 62% of revenue, while international sales represent approximately 38%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haichuan Intelligent operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling automatic weighing and batching equipment. It sources raw materials such as metals, electrical components, and electronics, and delivers finished products and integrated solutions to end users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing high-end intelligent weighing instruments and customized solutions. It aims to expand product lines with IoT-enabled water meters and advanced batching systems. Strategic plans include deepening cooperation with leading domestic and international clients, enhancing product differentiation, and expanding into high-end market segments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of automatic weighing instruments, inspection equipment, and related accessories. The company follows a direct sales and distributor sales model, with direct sales accounting for nearly 89% of revenue. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haichuan Intelligent is recognized as a leading domestic supplier capable of providing dynamic combination weighing and continuous automatic batching system solutions. Its products have been certified as high-tech and quality products in Guangdong Province. The company competes with both domestic and foreign manufacturers, offering competitive pricing and performance close to international standards, aiming to replace imported products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 225.5 million, representing a 12.62% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 36.2 million, a decrease of 11.6% year-over-year. Total assets reached around RMB 654 million, with steady growth in domestic market sales and stable international sales. The company maintains a solid financial position with ongoing investment in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haichuan Intelligent emphasizes high technical standards, product customization, and cost-effectiveness. Its products combine advanced technology with competitive pricing due to lower domestic labor and material costs. The company offers comprehensive services including design, manufacturing, installation, and training, positioning itself as a one-stop solution provider with strong brand recognition domestically and internationally under the 'HDM' trademark.
